assertions: Three actual configurations, three nonempty glyph comparisons and three palette comparisons per VM; callback/register identity and normal Windows exit.
case: Win3.1 guest-owned geometry changes between native continuations
setup: Each VM configures BIOS mode3 before each of three continuations; A uses8/16/8px fonts and B16/8/16px. Each captures actual glyphs/palette before admission and compares after completion.
limits: Not native-requested resize during an active command, arbitrary grids, graphics or original DOS active-codepage switching.
